pages.title: Quasicrystal Furnace
pages.text: A melt spun onto a cold wheel: cooled fast enough, its atoms freeze in an order that never repeats.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Set the cooling rate (as a power of ten, K/s) and the alloy's aluminium fraction. Five-fold order forms only between 10² and 10⁴ K/s, near 63% aluminium; slower, an ordinary crystal grows.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 1 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Quasicrystal Plate.
